g.title: Jungle A · Root delta
g.desc: Authored schematic. Blocking terrain surrounds clear route corridors; main teal solid, flank violet dashed. Recon can inspect the short delta crossing; lower riverbank offers a clean survivor return. North exploration adds two ambush corners; central rescue approach is watched from two branches.

g.title: Jungle B · Ruin spiral
g.desc: Authored schematic. Blocking terrain surrounds clear route corridors; main teal solid, flank violet dashed. Spiral ruins give a staged rescue: the short east canopy approach competes with a long inner ruin loop before survivor return. First shelf is shared; the long inner loop passes ambush pockets while the east approach exposes the party to two entry angles.

g.title: Jungle C · Three clearings
g.desc: Authored schematic. Blocking terrain surrounds clear route corridors; main teal solid, flank violet dashed. Two uneven approach clearings create a shorter exposed north route and longer south rally. All survivors cross the eastern junction; clearing both ambush arms delays extraction.
